**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
clientEvent target must be window, document, a ref-bound element or "media:(query)"
```

## How to fix

Pass window, document, a ref-bound local, or a string literal "media:(query)" as the clientEvent target.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { clientEvent } from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
export function A() { clientEvent("body", "click", () => {}); return <p />; }
```

```tsx prefer
import { clientEvent } from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
export function A() { clientEvent(document, "click", () => {}); return <p />; }
```

## When it is reported

Resume mode, server target.
